problems: Six owned slugs, five files: ba-athist-syria has no dossier because it was merged into republic-of-syria (Wikidata Q858, same 52-cell shape) as the brief directs for shared ids; colour and compile steps should alias it.

iraqi-republic (Q796) and republic-of-iraq (me-10-m) are one state, and state-of-kuwait (Q817) and kuwait (me-10-d) are one state; the later/other-batch rows were not taken, so each pair needs joining (one hue, one lineage). Cliopatria has no Iraq row for 2006-2013, and none for Kuwait in 1873-1960.

united-arab-republic ends September 1971 (rename to Arab Republic of Egypt) but Cliopatria's UAR row runs to 1972 and its Arab Republic of Egypt row starts in 1973, so 1972 has no row unless arab-republic-of-egypt starts in September 1971.

Five Syrian Cliopatria rows are one state (second-syrian-republic, UAR Syria part, republic-of-syria, arab-socialist-ba-ath-party, syria); the 1963 coup page makes 1961-1963 the restored Second Republic. Syria (me-10-l) carries Assyria's Wikidata Q41137.

Validator warnings left deliberately: occupation_start for state-of-israel with no later end in united-arab-republic (Sinai) and arab-socialist-ba-ath-party (Golan), both ending after the dossier; counterpart 'kurdistan-region' is not yet a slug (2 events in iraqi-republic); gazetteer warnings for the 4 unknown names above (resolve warnings: united-arab-republic 4 incl. the Sinai pairing, iraqi-republic 10, arab-socialist-ba-ath-party 1).

Modelling choices a reviewer may overturn: the 1990 Iraqi annexation of Kuwait is an occupation (hatched) in both dossiers, not an Iraqi gain; Kurdish autonomy 1992-2005 is a loss and a gain with counterpart kurdistan-region (a vassal tint is the alternative); the Iran-Iraq contest zone of 1980-1982 uses all of Khuzestan; Gaza under UAR administration 1959-1967 is an occupation with counterpart 'palestinians'.

Counterpart naming differs across batches: the Saudi dossier (another group) records the 1966 Kuwait neutral-zone partition with counterpart 'kuwait'; state-of-kuwait uses 'kingdom-of-saudi-arabia' for its side and 'kingdom-of-great-britain' for the protecting power.

Page budget: united-arab-republic 5 pages (at budget); iraqi-republic lists 6 (one over; a seventh, the Iraq-Saudi Arabia border page, was opened and replaced by the neutral-zone page); state-of-kuwait lists 3 (one over; the Kuwait-Saudi border page was opened first and replaced); arab-socialist-ba-ath-party lists 4 (two over, three shared with other dossiers); republic-of-syria 4 for two merged rows. 18 distinct pages were opened in all; sources_total counts per-dossier source entries (22).
